title: Compliance Management with Microsoft Purview

header.html: Describe the Microsoft Purview portal; Describe Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager; Describe the compliance score
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

html:
1Microsoft Purview

Microsoft Purview is a family of data governance, risk and compliance solutions. It helps you know your data, protect it, and meet regulations.

Area Examples
Data security Information Protection, DLP, Insider Risk Management
Data governance Data Map, Unified Catalog, data classification
Risk and compliance Compliance Manager, eDiscovery, Audit, Communication Compliance

2The Microsoft Purview portal

The Microsoft Purview portal (purview.microsoft.com) is the single place to manage these solutions: Compliance Manager, Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, eDiscovery, Audit, Insider Risk Management, data lifecycle management and more. Older Microsoft 365 compliance center and Microsoft Purview compliance portal names are earlier versions. Old wording [Verify live]

Access to features depends on licensing and role groups (for example Compliance Administrator).

Exam tip

. Purview portal = where compliance and data protection solutions live. Defender portal = threat protection. Know which portal does which.

Exam tip

. Purview portal = compliance and data solutions. Compliance Manager = assess controls against regulations and get improvement actions.

3Compliance Manager

Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager helps you understand and improve your compliance posture by assessing controls against regulations and standards and giving improvement actions.

Term Meaning
Assessment An evaluation of your controls against a regulation or standard (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, and others)
Template Starting point for an assessment
Control A requirement of the regulation
Improvement action A recommended step to meet a control
Solution The product feature that implements the action
Microsoft actions Controls Microsoft is responsible for
Your actions Controls you are responsible for (customer-managed)
Shared actions Responsibility split

Compliance Manager supports the shared responsibility idea: some actions are Microsoft's, some yours.

4Compliance score

The compliance score is a percentage that measures progress toward completing recommended improvement actions. It shows your overall posture and per-assessment scores.

Point Detail
Points Each action has points; higher-risk actions carry more
Microsoft-managed actions Add to the score automatically
Your actions You implement and test them to earn points
Meaning It is a measure of progress, not proof of compliance or a certification
Exam tip

. Compliance score (Purview) is not the same as secure score (Defender for Cloud and Microsoft 365). Compliance score = regulatory improvement actions. A high score does not guarantee legal compliance.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to assess its controls against GDPR and get recommended improvement actions. Which tool fits?

  • AMicrosoft Purview Compliance Manager
  • BAzure Bastion
  • CMicrosoft Sentinel
  • DDefender for Endpoint
Show the answer

Answer: A. Compliance Manager assesses controls against regulations and recommends actions.

S2What does the compliance score measure?

  • AThe number of users who signed in during the last month
  • BNetwork latency between the datacenters and the users
  • CPassword strength across all accounts in the directory
  • DProgress toward completing recommended improvement actions
Show the answer

Answer: D. It measures progress on improvement actions.

S3Which portal gives access to Compliance Manager, DLP and eDiscovery?

  • AAzure Key Vault
  • BMicrosoft Purview portal
  • CMicrosoft Defender portal only
  • DAzure Bastion
Show the answer

Answer: B. The Purview portal hosts compliance and data protection solutions.

S4In Compliance Manager, who performs a "Microsoft action"?

  • AThe customer
  • BMicrosoft
  • CThe auditor
  • DThe regulator
Show the answer

Answer: B. Microsoft actions are controls that Microsoft is responsible for.

S5A high compliance score means what?

  • AThe organization is legally compliant with every regulation
  • BProgress toward actions, but not proof of legal compliance
  • CThe organization has eliminated every compliance risk entirely
  • DAudits are not needed any more because the score proves compliance
Show the answer

Answer: B. The score shows progress and is not a guarantee of compliance.

S6What is an improvement action?

  • AA user license assigned in the admin center
  • BA recommended step to meet a control
  • CA firewall rule that blocks outside traffic
  • DA sign-in method for passwordless access
Show the answer

Answer: B. Improvement actions help satisfy controls.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is Microsoft Purview?

Show the answer

A family of data governance, risk and compliance solutions.

R2What is an assessment?

Show the answer

An evaluation of your controls against a regulation or standard.

R3What does the compliance score show?

Show the answer

Progress on recommended improvement actions.

R4What are the three action owners?

Show the answer

Microsoft, you and shared.

R5Which portal hosts Purview solutions?

Show the answer

The Microsoft Purview portal.

R6Is the compliance score proof of compliance?

Show the answer

No, it measures progress only.
